normal: only normalized query/topic/date/count and original native tool reach independent provider
cache a complete source before taking another root slot; all constraints, credential namespace, selected route and TTL participate

faults: no successful cache for partial/no-source answers, plain prose URLs, unmatched Messages results, or native tool errors
